visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a black T-shirt and grey shorts stands on a sandy beach with a rock formation and a bridge in the background; a woman in white is visible from behind. (2) Close-up shot of the man talking directly to the camera with a calm expression; he wears a black watch and a silver necklace. (3) The man holds a white bottle of sunscreen; camera zooms in slightly as yellow emphasis graphics appear around the product. (4) Close-up of the man's arm as he squeezes white cream from the bottle onto his skin and begins to rub it in. (5) The man points towards the ocean behind him and continues speaking with active hand gestures. (6) He holds a round, beige powder container towards the lens; the ChrisDan brand logo is clearly visible on the lid. (7) Close-up on the powder container as he opens it; a split-screen effect shows his face before and after applying the product, highlighting skin texture. (8) The man uses a white powder puff to pat his cheek and forehead; natural outdoor lighting highlights his facial features. (9) A large volume of water is splashed directly into the man's face; he remains static and closes his eyes as water drips off his shirt. (10) The man uses white tissues to firmly dab and press against his wet face to demonstrate makeup longevity; he holds a clean tissue up to the camera. (11) Transition to an indoor studio setting where a young child wearing a white lab coat and a frizzy white wig gestures like a scientist. (12) The child adds powder to a bowl of water and performs a waterproof test; the background is a neutral domestic interior. (13) Final graphic layout showing the sunscreen and powder products with water splash effects and brand logos.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main male creator, 1 child actor, 1 woman visible briefly in the background.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A middle-aged man in a casual black T-shirt and grey shorts; a young child in a scientist's lab coat and a white frizzy wig.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: An outdoor beach setting with sand, large coastal rocks, and a prominent bridge spanning over turquoise ocean water. Later, an indoor domestic setting with a glass table and simple background for the child's experiment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced acoustic guitar BGM begins with a clear, medium-pitched male voice narrating in Traditional Chinese. (2) A synthesized laughter SFX is heard as the male voice transitions to a more humorous tone. (3) A twinkling 'ding' SFX sounds when the sunscreen bottle is displayed, followed by continuous moderate-speed narration. (4) Vocal intensity increases during a music swell to emphasize product benefits. (5) A rhythmic 'pop' SFX accompanies the opening of the powder container. (6) A loud, broadband splash SFX represents water hitting a surface, followed by dabbing sounds. (7) Dramatic impact SFX and a 'whoosh' transition signify the shift to the child's segment. (8) A high-pitched, energetic child's voice begins speaking over a playful, toy-instrument-style BGM. (9) Bubbling and liquid-pouring SFX are heard clearly during the powder-in-water experiment. (10) An airy blowing sound SFX is followed by an upbeat, final branding jingle.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Demonstration -> Proof -> Science-Check -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To market ChrisDan brand sunscreen and powder by demonstrating their extreme waterproof and long-lasting capabilities through real-world and laboratory-style experiments.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct product demonstration, verbal recommendation, and constant presence of brand logos and slogans.
